steps.en: Open the web UI and paste the address of your live AI service
steps.zh: 打开 Web 界面，贴入运行中的 AI 服务地址

steps.en: Fingerprints the component and version, then matches it against the CVE rule library
steps.zh: 指纹识别组件与版本，再比对 CVE 规则库

steps.en: For MCP, skill, and jailbreak scans, runs LLM-driven probes through the model key you configured
steps.zh: 对 MCP、Skill、越狱评测，用你配置的模型跑 LLM 驱动的审计

steps.en: Read the report: component version, matched CVEs, severity, remediation links
steps.zh: 读报告：组件版本、命中的 CVE、严重级别和修复建议

value.en: A dated risk report on your AI services, MCP servers and skills — without writing a single probe yourself
value.zh: 不用自己写任何探测脚本，就拿到一份覆盖 AI 服务、MCP server 和 Skill 的风险报告

sources: README.md Quick Usage Guide (AI Infra Scan: enter http://127.0.0.1:8000, fingerprint, 2000+ CVEs, report with remediation links)
